source.dataset: Criteo Attribution Modeling for Bidding Dataset
source.terms: Criteo publishes this dataset under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Use here is limited to noncommercial offline research with attribution and ShareAlike obligations; the raw artifact is ignored and is not redistributed by this repository.
source.officialDescription: Each row is one timestamp-sorted impression with click, a conversion within 30 days after the impression, and attribution outcomes in the same population.

dataset.identityEvidence: Pinned Hugging Face revision response exposes X-Linked-Size 653015824 and X-Linked-ETag 94ac7a465564349bc7ba008602211d5990a3c53cc133abc0aadef61ea2391a98; the pipeline independently verifies local bytes and SHA-256 before parsing.
dataset.samplingRule: first 200000 physical impression rows from the pinned gzip in publisher-declared timestamp order; no label-conditioned sampling

labels.click: official click field: 1 when the impression was clicked
labels.rawConversion30d: official conversion field: 1 when a conversion occurred within 30 days after the impression, independently of whether this impression was the last click
labels.postClickCvrEvaluation: rawConversion30d evaluated only on clicked impressions
labels.attribution: audit-only official attribution field; excluded from features, training targets, model selection, and CVR/CTCVR metrics

features.leakagePolicy: all outcomes, identifiers tied to outcomes, and click-history fields are excluded

split.strategy: fixed contiguous blocks over the publisher-declared timestamp-sorted first 200000 rows
split.selection: train fits parameters; dev selects checkpoints; test is consumed once only after all checkpoints are frozen

training.selection: naive uses minimum clicked-dev CVR LogLoss; ESMM uses minimum dev CTR LogLoss plus dev CTCVR LogLoss; test cannot select any parameter

models.naiveClickedOnlyCvr: one CVR tower optimized only on clicked train impressions
models.esmm: shared impression features with separate CTR and conditional-CVR towers; P(CTCVR)=P(CTR)*P(CVR)

limitations: This V1 uses a fixed 200000-row timestamp-ordered prefix, not all 16.5M impressions or the full 30-day span.

The official raw conversion label is impression-associated within 30 days and must not be described as last-click or causal post-click conversion; ESMM CTCVR is explicitly click multiplied by raw conversion.
Repeated users and conversion timelines may cross temporal boundaries; uid and conversion_id are excluded from features, but the fixed prefix is not a user- or conversion-group holdout.
Criteo anonymizes and subsamples the traffic, and contextual feature meanings are undisclosed.
Cost is transformed by the publisher and is not a real market price.
The publisher's legacy go.criteo.net archive link returned HTTP 404 on 2026-08-27; acquisition uses the same dataset in Criteo's official Hugging Face organization at a pinned revision.
Offline public-data metrics do not establish KAI production performance, online lift, or business impact.
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 limits this use to noncommercial purposes under its attribution and ShareAlike terms.
